name: Hailiang Agriculture
verdict: Hailiang Agriculture (海粮农业), a private Chinese grain group: Liaoning Hailiang Agriculture Group, which signed the Liaoning Tieren partnership, is a wholly-owned subsidiary, and parent Shanghai Hailiang Agriculture Group is held by natural persons Lu Yiming and Wang Abing. Nothing found.
aliases: 辽宁海粮农业集团有限公司
上海海粮农业集团有限公司
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Liaoning Tieren for the 2026 CSL season; the club announced the strategic partnership on 11 January 2026 (Dongqiudi/Tencent News). Rating note: ownership documented (claim hailiang-agriculture-ownership: two natural-person shareholders, per the group's own subsidiaries page and a registry aggregator). No state in the chain, and a check for court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights findings against the group found none (searched 2026-10-03).
